text:
mike carter: heads up — p95 on the latency dashboard jumped ~40ms right after we split traffic for /v2/embed. looks like a rollup merge artifact, not real latency.

sara li: ugh. can you paste the rollup ids / routes involved?

mike carter: route A -> route A:blue and A:green (traffic split). dashboard shows endpoint:/v2/embed p50 stable, p95/p99 shifted up. counts for green are tiny (~12 samples) vs blue (~1200).

jen park: small-sample noise is expected but that size gap shouldn't shift the merged p95 that much unless merge algo is weird. are we doing tdigest merge without weight safeguards?

mike carter: looks like it. I pulled the s3 rollup blobs — some of the sketches for green have only a couple centroids, and one was serialized with zero-sample metadata (intentionally?) but still gets merged.

kai: deploy-bot reported a config change to rollup aggregation last week: `rollup.merge_mode=tdigest-default` and `tdigest.compress=100`. maybe compression + tiny sketches produce centroid drift when merged with a large sketch.

jen park: compression shouldn't create positive bias but merging an empty/near-empty sketch can move centroids if weights not handled correctly. we used to attach sample_count field, but does console aggregator honor it?

anna r.: quick idea — if sample_count < 50, don't merge into global percentile; instead show as a separate low-sample bucket and annotate dashboard with "low sample" badge. that avoids noisy p95 jumps during rollouts.

mike carter: agree UX flagging helps. but also think we should stop treating zero-count sketches as valid contributors. I saw blobs with `count=0` but non-empty centroid list — clearly a serializer bug.

sara li: can we add a short-term filter: ignore any sketch with count < 5 OR count==0 when computing rollups? that would be fast to patch in the rollup service.

jen park: yes, implementable. long-term we should: 1) validate serializer to never emit centroid payloads when count==0; 2) change merge algorithm to do weighted merge by sample_count and clamp centroid offsets for tiny contributors; 3) surface `sample_count` column in dashboard and add CI shading for p95/p99.

kai: opened a quick PR to add the ignore filter and a metric `rollup.sketches.ignored.low_count`. link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/rollup/+/3753 — will run canary.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: rollup-service patch `ignore-low-count-sketches` -> canary cluster at 2026-03-20T15:44:00Z. CI: 12/12 passed.

mike carter: thanks. also can we add a small note in the console near percentile metric that says: "percentiles may be unstable for combined routes with uneven sample counts" — less surprise for platform SREs.

anna r.: agree. I'll sketch a tiny UX mock: show sample_count and a tooltip "samples < 50 — treat percentiles as low confidence". also add a rollout gating rule: don't show combined percentiles until both groups > 100 samples OR after 10m warmup.

jen park: sounds good. created an issue to follow up on serializer/merge alg improvements: https://git.internal/r/redwood/obs/issue/4892

sara li: after canary lands, can someone re-run the split and paste new dashboard screenshots? want to confirm the jump goes away.

mike carter: will do. thx everyone. :thumbsup:
